scope: Completed H0/H1 saved-data verification and independent selected fixed-interval scalar references; no neural simulation or producer/kernel/metric helper imports
limits: Full global voltage trajectories between checkpoints are not reconstructed. Selected48 p/h and direct/reset algebra are checked at every tick; independent H integration is limited to the predeclared saved reference intervals.
Global winner optimality over unselected cells is not independently reconstructible without an all-cell time cube; selected-population dominance and saved state/selection identity are checked.
Global accepted/unavailable edge totals are checked as a partition; exact full-graph delivery visits and selected event dispositions are reconstructed.
Numerical accuracy and the lower bound do not establish physiology, seed robustness, or H1 promotion.
